title: Joshua Kushner’s Thrive Holdings is acquiring ADT for $7.6 billion
description: The Joshua Kushner-led Thrive Holdings is acquiring ADT in an all-cash deal valued at $7.6 billion. The deal is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027 and will take ADT private, as reported earlier by Bloomberg.
